children.text: At King Spa, we strive to make your visit as convenient and seamless as possible. Here’s how you can plan your relaxing day with us:

• Weekday Visit: If you prefer a calmer environment with less people, consider purchasing a weekday pass (Mon – Thu).
  • Weekend Visit: If you like to socialize and be around a fun crowd, consider purchasing a weekend pass (Fri – Sun).

children.cls: elementor-element elementor-element-5285a010 elementor-icon-list--layout-traditional elementor-list-item-link-full_width elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-list

children.cls: elementor-element elementor-element-1e0ae0d5 elementor-icon-list--layout-traditional elementor-list-item-link-full_width elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-list
children.html:
• On-Site Booking: Spa treatments must be booked on-site. Simply visit our reservation desk on the second-floor upon arrival to schedule your preferred treatments. See our current spa treatment pricing.
  • First-Come, First-Served: All spa treatments at King Spa are available on a first-come, first-served basis to ensure fair access for all guests. We recommend booking your treatment early to secure your spot.

children.html:
What are the operating hours of King Spa?

King Spa is open from 9 AM to 11 PM Sunday through Thursday, and from 9 AM to 12 AM on Friday and Saturday.

Doors will close promptly at closing time, so we kindly ask that you plan to exit the building by then.

What are the outdoor pool hours?

The outdoor pool is open from 10 AM to 10 PM Sunday through Thursday, and from 10 AM to 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.

Do I need to make a reservation for spa treatments?

All spa treatments are available on a first-come, first-served basis and must be booked on-site upon arrival.

What does my day pass include?

Your day pass includes access to:

  • Locker Room & Showers
  • 10+ Saunas & Steam Rooms
  • Outdoor & Indoor Bade Pools
  • Jacuzzis & Cold Plunge Pool
  • Media Room & Indoor Lounges
  • Spa Uniform
  • Towels & Toilet Trees
Where can I find pricing information for admission and spa treatments?

For detailed pricing information visit our admission passes page and our spa treatments page.

Visit our FAQ page for more info.
